name: inspira-line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
blurb: Glowing underline traces beneath text on a loop.
description: A horizontal line shadow animates beneath text, creating a glow effect that pulses continuously without stopping.
use_when: Accent heading or featured text that needs subtle visual emphasis.
avoid_when: Small body text or dense layouts — the shadow adds visual weight and can make text harder to read.
a11y: Purely decorative animation on text. No focus or keyboard impact.
